reference_policy: Each caption uses its fixed CLAP top-1 retrieved proxy; KL(reference || generated).

baseline.scheduler_rng_policy: fresh scheduler per piece; seed global RNG and noise_sampler_seed when supported

schedule_only.scheduler_rng_policy: fresh scheduler per piece; seed global RNG and noise_sampler_seed when supported

rescale_only.scheduler_rng_policy: fresh scheduler per piece; seed global RNG and noise_sampler_seed when supported

combined.scheduler_rng_policy: fresh scheduler per piece; seed global RNG and noise_sampler_seed when supported

effect_definitions.schedule_main_effect: mean of schedule-on minus off across rescale levels
effect_definitions.rescale_main_effect: mean of rescale-on minus off across schedule levels

interpretation.CLAP: higher is closer global caption/audio alignment
interpretation.KL-PASST-softmax-retrieved-proxy: lower is closer to a retrieved proxy, not ground truth
interpretation.rms_peak_clipping: signal diagnostics, not musical quality or human preference
interpretation.confidence_intervals: Exploratory paired percentile bootstrap over captions; no multiple-comparison correction. One fixed seed per caption, so seed uncertainty is not estimated.
interpretation.subset_fd: Set-level descriptive score with a small cohort; no per-caption FD or artificial window sample count.
